{{Top|leg}}
'''Category Ten''' was the highest category of threat designated to escapees on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Prisoners with Category Ten status were to be killed on sight by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] authorities.
